items.t: Said he would never understand how some colleagues could ignore or deny the president's attack on a free press, his character attacks on those who disagreed with him, and his distance from the truth.

record.t: Was first elected Lieutenant Governor of Washington in 2020.

record.t: Was elected as a Democrat to the 113th Congress and the three succeeding Congresses, serving from January 2013 to January 2021.
